top_signals.title: Iran’s Oil Minister Resigns as U.S. Blockade Chokes Crude Exports
top_signals.summary: Iran’s oil minister has resigned as the U.S. blockade pushes the country’s crude exports and oil revenues toward zero, handing control of Iran’s most important industry to the head of the National Iranian Oil Company. President Masoud Pezeshkian accepted Mohsen Paknejad’s resignation on Sunday and appointed NIOC chief Hamid Bovard as acting oil minister, according to Reuters.
